jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced Senior HEOR Manager/Clinical Outcome Assessment (COA) Strategy Lead to drive the development, implementation, and execution of strategic COA plans across a diverse portfolio of clinical development programs and therapeutic areas. This role serves as the company’s subject matter expert in COA and Patient-Reported Outcomes (PROs), ensuring that clinical outcome strategies support regulatory, reimbursement, and health technology assessment (HTA) objectives globally.

The successful candidate will provide scientific leadership across cross-functional teams, oversee COA methodology and validation activities, and ensure patient-centered endpoints are developed and implemented in accordance with regulatory expectations and industry best practices.

Location: Basel

Start date: 01/12/2026

End date:

30/11/2027

Key Responsibilities

COA Strategy Development & Leadership
• Lead the development, creation, and execution of strategic COA plans across clinical development programs and therapeutic areas.
• Own and maintain the COA Strategy Document for assigned programs, including timelines, evidence-generation plans, and validation milestones for regulatory and HTA submissions.
• Provide strategic guidance on the selection and optimization of COAs for clinical trials to support clinical, regulatory, and market access objectives.
• Ensure alignment of COA strategies with global regulatory requirements and evolving scientific standards.

Clinical Development Support
• Guide clinical teams in the selection, implementation, and interpretation of COAs throughout the clinical trial lifecycle.
• Provide expert input into clinical documents, including:

Study protocols

Statistical Analysis Plans (SAPs)

Psychometric Analysis Plans

Clinical Study Reports (CSRs)

Briefing books and regulatory submissions
• Serve as the accountable owner for COA-related content within protocols and SAPs.
• Ensure COA-related responsibilities are appropriately defined within program RACI frameworks across Clinical Operations, Biostatistics, Regulatory Affairs, and other functions.

COA Project Execution
• Lead and oversee the scientific execution of COA initiatives from concept through completion.
• Collaborate with internal stakeholders, including

Clinical Development

Medical Affairs, Regulatory Affairs

Market Access
• Manage external vendors delivering qualitative research, translations, linguistic validation, and eCOA implementation activities.
• Ensure adherence to timelines, quality standards, and project objectives.

Data Analysis, Reporting & Publications
• Partner with biostatisticians, psychometricians, data managers, and clinicians to analyze and interpret COA data.
• Lead development of COA analysis plans and review psychometric analysis reports.
• Ensure COA findings are clearly linked to clinical benefit, patient value, and HTA decision-making criteria.
• Contribute to and review: Regulatory dossiers, Scientific advice packages, FDA and EMA briefing documents, White papers, Manuscripts, Poster and oral presentations

Regulatory & Scientific Engagement
• Lead preparation of COA-related documentation for regulatory interactions and submissions.
• Support meetings with health authorities and scientific advisory bodies.
• Prepare and review dossiers, briefing books, scientific advice materials, and other regulatory communications.
• Collaborate closely with Regulatory Affairs, Clinical Development, and Medical Writing teams.

Thought Leadership & External Engagement
• Maintain deep expertise in COA, PRO, and health outcomes research methodologies.
• Monitor emerging scientific developments, guidance, and best practices from organizations such as:

C-Path Institute

PCORI

ISPOR

ISOQOL
• Integrate innovative approaches and methodological advancements into development programs.
• Represent the organization externally through scientific collaborations, publications, and professional engagements.

Required Qualifications
• Master’s degree or PhD in Life Sciences

Contract end date: 1 October 2027

Key Responsibilities
• Coordinate with architects, engineering partners, fire protection specialists, project teams, and the site fire brigade.
• Lead the technical oversight of fire protection systems, including sprinkler systems, deluge systems, dry extinguishing systems, firewater networks, and firewater retention solutions.
• Manage contractors and vendors responsible for technical fire protection installations.
• Ensure project delivery with respect to cost, schedule, quality, and compliance requirements.
• Participate in 3D design reviews and multidisciplinary coordination to resolve clashes and technical issues.
• Oversee commissioning, functional testing, and acceptance activities for fire protection systems.
• Participate in integrated system tests together with engineering teams, contractors, and stakeholders.

• Extensive experience working with fire protection systems and related regulations, standards, and guidelines (e.g., VKF, SES).
• Experience within pharmaceutical, biotechnology, chemical, or industrial manufacturing environments.
• Strong understanding of GMP and cleanroom environments is advantageous.
• Approximately 5-10 years of engineering, project execution, or operational experience within the pharmaceutical, biotech, chemical, or related industries
• VKF certification such as "Fachperson für Wasserlöschanlagen VKF" is considered a strong advantage.
• Technical expertise in fire protection systems and infrastructure

• Structured and detail-oriented working style.
• Ability to work independently in complex, multidisciplinary project environments.

jobs.description:
We are looking for a Material Declaration Expert (Product Safety Specialist) to ensure Diagnostics Instruments, Consumables and Packaging deliver life-saving results and meet the highest global environmental compliance and sustainability standards.

This role is key to supporting global data transformation, focusing on migrating diagnostics instruments, consumables, and packaging data from legacy systems to the new S/4HANA Data Management platform.

Start Date: asap

Latest Possible Start Date: 01.01.2027

Planned Duration of Employment: 31.05.2027

Location: Basel or Rotkreuz

Home office: 2 days/week

Travel: 5 %, e.g. for Workshops

Responsibilities:
• Support a Global Data Migration Project to migrate large sets of Chemical Legislation Data from the current SAP EHSM Solution to the new Solution in EHSM S4 HANA.
• Drive the modernization of our chemical data model by translating and transforming chemical data structures from legacy systems into S4/HANA-compatible formats to ensure seamless data migration
• Assure global environmental regulatory compliance and sustainability for our Diagnostic Instruments, Consumables, and Packaging. This encompasses adherence to a broad spectrum of global regulations, including e.g. REACH, RoHS, California Proposition 65, TSCA, POP, Conflict Minerals, and the Packaging Directive.
• Ensure data accuracy and integrity by preparing load files and performing post-load verification checks applying automation and mass load tools
• Drive operational efficiency by simplifying processes, emphasizing the automation of manual tasks and promoting automated report generation.
• Actively contribute to project meetings by offering valuable insights, updates, and subject-matter expertise
• Utilize project management tools to monitor project health, ensure timely execution, and maintain momentum across key milestones.

Requirements:
• A degree in Engineering, Natural Sciences, Material Sciences, Data/Information Sciences , or a related field, fundamentally combined with a strong focus on chemistry and data management.
• Experience managing complex data in the (medical) device, electronics, automotive, aerospace, or precision/high-tech manufacturing industry in the product safety environment (e.g. EH&S data management, material declaration, product stewardship ).
• Relevant knowledge of environmental regulatory frameworks, including global environmental regulations such as REACH, RoHS, California Proposition 65, TSCA, POP, Conflict Minerals, and the Packaging Directive. A good understanding of the chemical composition of materials used in instruments, electronic devices and packaging.
• Expertise in migrating chemical compliance, regulatory, or similar sensitive data while upholding strict data integrity and governance standards.
• In-depth experience with interactive, re al-time Tableau dashboards and data pipelines in Snowflake.
• Experience utilizing Material Declaration Data Management Systems for the comprehensive evaluation, maintenance, and verification of large-scale material declaration datasets (such as SAP EH&S(M) or equivalents).
• Experience with solutions leveraging Python, RPA, VBA and SAP GUI Scripting and basic and advanced AI tools (e.g ONA)

Job profile
• Life Sciences - Engineering
• Basel-Stadt
• Contracting
• Part Time, 100%
• Immediately - 31.05.2027
• EHS (Environment, Health & Safety), product safety, material declaration

Siamo alla ricerca di un esperto di dichiarazione dei materiali (Product Safety Specialist) per garantire strumenti diagnostici, materiali di consumo e imballaggio fornire risultati salvavita e soddisfare i più elevati standard globali di conformità ambientale e sostenibilità.

Questo ruolo è fondamentale per supportare la trasformazione globale dei dati, concentrandosi sulla migrazione di strumenti diagnostici, materiali di consumo e dati di imballaggio dai sistemi legacy alla nuova piattaforma S/4HANA Data Management.

Data di inizio: asap

Data di inizio: 01.01.2027

Durata dell'occupazione: 31.05.2027

Posizione: Basilea o Rotkreuz

Sede: 2 giorni/settimana

Viaggi: 5 %, ad esempio per i Laboratori

Responsabilità:
• Sostenere un Global Data Migration Project per migrare grandi serie di dati di legislazione chimica dall'attuale soluzione SAP EHSM alla nuova Soluzione in EHSM S4 HANA.
• Guidare l'ammodernamento del nostro modello di dati chimici traducendo e trasformando le strutture di dati chimici dai sistemi legacy in formati S4/HANA-compatibili per garantire la migrazione dei dati senza soluzione di continuità
• Assicurare la conformità normativa ambientale globale e la sostenibilità per i nostri strumenti diagnostici, consumabili e imballaggio. Ciò comprende l'adesione ad un ampio spettro di normative globali, tra cui REACH, RoHS, California Proposition 65, TSCA, POP, Conflict Minerals, e la Direttiva Packaging.
• Assicurare l'accuratezza e l'integrità dei dati preparando i file di carico e effettuando controlli di verifica post-carico che applicano strumenti di automazione e di carico di massa
• Guidare l'efficienza operativa semplificando i processi, sottolineando l'automazione delle attività manuali e promuovendo la generazione di report automatizzati.
• Contribuisci attivamente alle riunioni di progetto offrendo preziose conoscenze, aggiornamenti e competenze su argomenti
• Utilizzare gli strumenti di gestione del progetto per monitorare la salute del progetto, garantire l'esecuzione tempestiva e mantenere slancio attraverso le pietre miliari chiave.

Requisiti:
• Una laurea in Ingegneria, Scienze Naturali, Scienze dei Materiali, Scienze dei Dati/Informazione o un campo correlato, fondamentalmente combinato con una forte attenzione alla chimica e alla gestione dei dati.
• Esperienza di gestione dei dati complessi nel dispositivo (medico), elettronica, automotive, aerospaziale, o settore manifatturiero di precisione/alta tecnologia nell'ambiente di sicurezza del prodotto (ad es. gestione dei dati EH&S, dichiarazione materiale, stewardship del prodotto).
• Conoscenza rilevante dei quadri normativi ambientali, compresi i regolamenti ambientali globali come REACH, RoHS, California Proposition 65, TSCA, POP, Conflict Minerals, e la Direttiva Packaging. Una buona comprensione della composizione chimica dei materiali utilizzati in strumenti, dispositivi elettronici e imballaggi.
• Competenza nella migrazione della conformità chimica, della regolamentazione o di dati sensibili simili, mantenendo rigide integrità dei dati e standard di governance.
• Esperienza approfondita con dashboard e datadotti interattivi e re al-time di Tableau a Snowflake.
• Esperienza che utilizza i sistemi di gestione dei dati della dichiarazione dei materiali per la valutazione completa, la manutenzione e la verifica dei dataset di dichiarazione dei materiali di grandi dimensioni (come SAP EH&S(M) o equivalenti).
• Esperienza con soluzioni che sfruttano Python, RPA, VBA e SAP GUI Scripting e strumenti AI di base e avanzati (ad esempio ONA)

Date de début: dès que

Lieu: Bâle ou Rotkreuz

Cabinet : 2 jours/semaine

Responsabilités :
• Soutenir un projet mondial de migration de données pour migrer de grandes séries de données de législation chimique de la solution SAP EHSM actuelle vers la nouvelle solution dans EHSM S4 HANA.
• Conduire la modernisation de notre modèle de données chimiques en transformant et transformant les structures de données chimiques des systèmes existants en formats compatibles S4/HANA pour assurer une migration de données transparente
